item.title: RFK Jr.’s HHS proposes scrapping protections for LGBTQ+ kids in foster care
item.description: The U.S. Department of Health and Human Services has proposed formally removing federal regulations intended to ensure supportive foster placements for LGBTQ children, following a court decision that struck down the rule last year. Foster homes could soon reject LGBTQ+ children after President Donald Trump’s administration proposed a new rule that would strip protections in place since 2024.
